Miguel Farouk
miguel.farouk@example.com | Cleveland, OH
Miguel Farouk has 9 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Ironwood Data (2023-2026), where they
led migration of core services at Ironwood Data onto AWS, improving uptime
during peak load. Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Larkspur Platform
(2021-2023). Before that, Backend Engineer at Quartzline Technologies
(2017-2021). Education: B.S. Computer Engineering, University of Florida, 2016.
Core skills: Distributed systems, PostgreSQL, Node.js, AWS.
